messages.author: bb37bae01bd466aa
messages.subject: Resource utilization = Inf
parts:
Hi, 

See the attached resources.csv which I obtained using:

resources <- get_mon_resources(env)

The file includes several resources (with similar capacity) for which I am interested in the utilization. Arrivals are sent to each of the 8 resources using round-robin policy so I would expect the utilizations to be somewhat in line with each other. Which is true for 7 out of the 8 resources.
When running:

plot(resources, metric="utilization", "pickOperatorRegion5")

Utilization is found to be Inf no matter how large I set the capacity for that resource. The other 7 pickOperatorRegionXs have a utilization around 40-50%.

When comparing server and capacity, such a high utilization seems unlikely. Therefore, could there something be wrong in Simmer's utilization calculation?
